discoveries.sourceDerivedIssue: Phase1 statblock page 95 is an introduction; actual printed CL9 block begins p96. Preserve unchanged Phase1 identity/locator until independent page-map reconciliation.
Hyperdrive x2 uses 10-jump utility-droid memory; no full utility-droid station skills stated.
Eight proton torpedoes accompany a pilot-controlled alternative weapon group.
10-jump memory utility droid is printed; independent crew contribution is not quantified.
Narrative reports missing motivators/inertial dampeners on defective factory units; stock published x3 hyperdrive should not be overwritten.
No SR line; unknown/unstated is not zero or proven unshielded.
Pilot +2 equipment bonus explicitly only if untrained in Pilot.
Escape configuration modifies existing statblock on p99, including SR, capacity and hyperdrive; not an independent Phase1 identity.
The base p98 statblock has no hyperdrive field; the p99 escape variation includes x2 and x10 backup.
Gunner lasers and pilot missiles use separate attacks; light concussion missiles have printed payload 12.
Crew5 expert stock; narrative says operable effectively with pilot and one other; requires operational crew stations and capacity logic.
Two cockpits/two gunner pods and 2+2 printed cannons; spare mounting point count/arcs unspecified.
+5 equipment only to Mechanics checks to install weapon systems, not global Mechanics.
No hyperdrive entry printed; do not infer a speed multiplier.
No statted weapons despite narrative minor defensive systems; weapon list empty due to absent printed attacks, not proof of no hardware.
Passengers 10 standard configuration; carried craft varies by mission.
Forgo attacks as standard action for 2-square-radius allied +1 Reflex and +10 Fortitude AND damage threshold.
Three weapon group types each show 2 batteries; detailed gunners 4,3,3; physical mounts within each battery unspecified.
Tractor batteries printed attack +11, size target variant -9 and grapple +63; requires non-damage resolution.
-20 penalty on turret/tractor attacks against target smaller than Colossal is printed.
Section title Jedi Covenant Shuttle; actual CL6 statblock is Baronial-class Yacht.
Narrative indicates models vary, but gives no second full statblock.
Standard action forgo all attacks; enemy starships in 2-square area -1 Reflex and -2 speed min1.
Four projectors, +8 3x3 starship area, damage Special (SG45); SG45 effect must be resolved from source authority before automation.
5/6/3 battery group counts and 4 gravity projectors explicitly printed but firing arcs and constituent mounts not.
Tractor beam attacks +10 (-10 vs targets smaller than Colossal), non-damage grapple +61.
-20 against smaller-than-Colossal applies on asterisked medium turbolaser and tractor attacks.
Standard action forgo all attacks; 2-square area; only allied Colossal (frigate)+ ships versus enemy Colossal (frigate)+ ships gain +1 damage die with vehicle weapons.
Six medium turbolaser, six heavy ion, six point-defense light laser, three tractor batteries printed, but each battery constituent count/arc unknown.
Heavy ion batteries deal 3d10x5 ion, not ordinary kinetic damage; optional -20 smaller-than-Colossal penalty.
Crew 31,452, troops 7,400, cargo 32,000 tons, and 96 carried Sith interceptors; preserve distinct passenger and carried craft domains.
Ranged text names point-defense medium blaster cannon battery but detail names point-defense laser cannon battery; do not overwrite one.
No numerical SR in the printed statblock. Narrative says lack of shielding; record as source silence with narrative evidence, not invented numeric SR=0.
Standard action forgo all attacks; boost allied missile/torpedo attacks against enemies in adjacent squares by one damage die.
Payload 60 concussion missiles shared with named heavy concussion missile battery; number of actual launchers not specified.
Shuttle-only model passengers 10, cargo 15 tons and estimated value 222,500 vs base 5/70 tons/120,000. Do not create a new Phase1 identity.
Pilot controls light turbolasers, copilot controls point defense; complete independent firing arcs still unspecified.
No printed hyperdrive or numeric SR; minimal life support and environmental suit recommendation narrative does not create numeric equipment fields.
Only one day consumables; narrative recommends environmental suits in case of ejection.
Fire-link specifically names concussion missiles, with 12 missiles and 4-square splash; independent tubes and fire-link ammunition consumption not sourced.
Aurek fire-link applies to heavy lasers, not its proton torpedoes; both attacks are pilot operated.
Proton torpedoes 9d10x2 with 4-square splash and payload 6; wing position narrative provides no modifier.
CX additional fuel; CXB greater cargo/shipboard stowage variation described with no distinct numerical statblock.
Passengers 5 plus 2 bulk-loader droids; droids must not silently count as standard passenger slots or gunner crew.
No SR line printed in Conductor block; source absence is not certified zero.
Header Init -1 but Skills Initiative +0, both printed p182. Cannot resolve by choosing one.
Ranged medium laser cannons vs detail double laser cannons; possible caliber/config compatibility, but exact combined designation is not printed.
Narrative explicitly says orbital shuttles lack hyperdrives; treat as narrative-established absence rather than missing multiplier.
Prose references stronger shield versions for Flashpoint Station, without alternate printed values.
Forego attacks as standard action; adjacent squares: +5 Pilot checks for allies resisting dogfight or escaping; no unconditional +5 Pilot bonus.
Ranged line identifies 2 medium turbolaser batteries, detail states 5 gunners for group; individual physical mounts/arcs not printed.
Crew 40 to 100 (skilled), not a single constant count.
400 bipedal droid passenger load can discharge in <5 min; launch/deploy behavior has no explicit finer-grained action mechanics.
Pilot -6 and Initiative -4 appear in the statblock; do not recalculate.
Synchronized Systems: standard action + comms + within 10 squares + normal condition; then substitute Use Computer +12; drop on range/condition/operator termination.
2-square Tactical Fire changes attack rolls vs either Reflex or Fortitude (commander choice), not generic all-defense bonus.
Four double light turbo, two medium turbo, two point-defense light laser, one tractor battery; arcs and constituent turret counts not supplied.
Allied ships within 2 squares may move 1 square at start of their own turns, granted by standard action forgoing all attacks.
Hammerheads linked in normal condition and within 10 squares may use Inexpugnable Use Computer +12; narrative up to 64 coordinations not automated as mechanical limit.
Carries named fighter/transport classes with separate counts; protect crew vs passengers vs carried craft.
Laser OR missile attack, autofire and fire-link apply only to laser; missiles 3 payload 4-square splash.
Stock Neo-Crusader design differs from earlier modified fighters; no separate complete variant statblock.
Main Ranged missile +14 but detailed missile +10.
Payload 50 medium concussion missiles but weapon row says point-defense light concussion missile battery.
Ground bombardment missile batteries may be configured for space targets; no numerical alternate statblock.
Colossal space transport has gunner-operated double laser cannons (not pilot by inference).
Separate character-scale 14 and starship-scale 3 fly squares, 1000 km/h stated.
Forgo all attacks standard action; all enemy ships adjacent suffer -1 Reflex and Fortitude.
Three named bank types but not multiplicity or arcs; cannot derive counts from narrative plural.
Tactical Fire +2 circumstance attack bonus to allies making attack runs against targets in 2-square radius only.
Point-defense medium ion batteries 4d10x2 ion, not ordinary damage; 4 attack groups as separate mounts unresolved.
Missile/torpedo attack successful in 2-square area grants +1 attack and avoids secondary missile attack penalty with locked target.
Fission warheads mentioned in narrative, not default equipment, do not auto-apply to 120 missiles.
Colossal* transport counts as Gargantuan starfighter for capital ship weapon targeting, dogfight, maneuvers only.
Grp +6 printed despite Strength 44/Colossal; preserve literal unless confirmed erratum, do not autocorrect.
Copilot docking gun blaster cannon +5, 3d12 is character-scale-only, not starship-scale mount.
Volatile fighter deals 8d6 instead of 4d6 in collision; not same as normal weapon damage or self-destruct effect.
No numerical hyperdrive or SR printed; do not assign a default.
Tactical Fire enables allied engineers within 2-square radius to reroute power with one swift action; nonstacking.
Printed Fighting Space is 2 squares starship scale, not 2x2 or radius=2.
Main Ranged light laser attack +10, detail +8.
Main Ranged medium laser attack +8, detail +10.
Stygium cloak grants total concealment; detect with -10 notice penalty, notice does not negate concealment.
Prose mentions minefield but statblock has no mine weapon group/ammunition/procedure.
